about: The emotes module's Settings row, for the UI kit's Settings check (UI kit 0.30.0+, framework F110). Each row: its id in content/ui/settings.json, readBy = patterns (JavaScript regex source) that mean the game's own code passes the row on to this module, hint = what to do when nothing does. Copied into the game with the module — don't edit the game's copy.

rows.hint: pass it to the emotes module: applyEmoteSetting(emotes, loadSettings(settingsJson)) at start-up and applyEmoteSetting(emotes, values) in the Settings onChange (src/emotes/settingsRow.ts)
